analysis:
The PR raises the SSD write-behind queue bound from 2 to 6 via SSDPrefixCachePolicy.writeQueueMaxJobs (line ~245 head). The same constant now sets the BoundedSingleConsumerPipeline capacity (SSDHybridCheckpointStore.swift:111, previously 1) and the `writing` gate in prepareWriteJob (+Write.swift:175, previously a hard-coded 2). Security-relevant behavior was examined against T-041 (the prefix-cache at-rest tier).

No change to crypto, HMAC lookup tags, cacheSalt scoping, TTL, KEK handling, epoch checks, root-safety checks or the on-disk format. All of prepareWriteJob's validation (identity, cacheSalt, prefix tokens, safe root, epoch) still runs before a job is admitted, and performWrite's checks are unchanged. The at-rest exposure is the same in kind; at most there are slightly more donations persisted instead of dropped, all under the existing 30-minute TTL, disk budget and daily write rate limiter. Per-job admission still goes through rateLimiter.admission and a consume at write time.

Availability and memory: each queued complete-checkpoint job holds donor state and I/O scratch (the ProcessHostBufferReservation of ioScratchBytes is reserved via kvBudget before queuing). Up to 6 such jobs could be held, compared with 2-3 before. Reservations are charged to the budget and refused when unavailable (hostMemoryUnavailable), so live serving is protected. The code comment acknowledges longer-held donor memory and stream-end latency under write backlog. This is a bounded, accounted resource tradeoff rather than a concrete regression. Note that the `writing` set is checked under `lock`, and the pipeline capacity equals the gate, so submit failure (writeQueueFull) should not occur for admitted jobs. The finish/settle paths remain idempotent via the completion callback nil-out.

Unverified: whether the attention-block SSDWriteBehind path (not supplied) uses writeQueueMaxJobs with its own byte caps. The BoundedSingleConsumerPipeline semantics (whether capacity counts the in-flight job) were not supplied. The impact of 6 retained donor states on memory pressure is unverified, and the engine's behavior while delaying stream-end was not visible. No finding is reported.
